I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# Look at the 3-cells pattern structure: top block rows2-5 cols4-6 (4x3) and bottom block rows13-14 cols8-9 (2x2). Both are full rectangular blocks of 3.
# Fill candidates: check if filling via nearest non-3 cell (BFS / flood from outside the block, i.e., replace each 3 with neighbor value) reproduces demo output. Test: BFS from outer cells through neighbors, value propagates.
from collections import deque
def fill_block(I):
    Hh=Ww=len(I)
    blk=set((i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if I[i][j]==3)
    # multi-source BFS starting at non-3 cells adjacent to block
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    seen=set(blk)
    q=deque()
    for a,b in sorted(blk):
        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            na,nb=a+da,b+db
            if 0<=na<Hh and 0<=nb<Ww and I[na][nb]!=3 and (na,nb) not in seen:
                out[a][b]=I[na][nb]; seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
    # propagate inside holes? only one pass may fail for inner 3s
    while q:
        a,b=q.popleft()
        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            na,nb=a+da,b+db
            if 0<=na<Hh and 0<=nb<Ww and out[na][nb]==3:
                out[na][nb]=out[a][b]; q.append((na,nb))
    return out
print(fill_block(I)==O)
